text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type vocabulary tags en 自己经营 zh

text_en: I spent my childhood in Paris.
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en I spent my childhood in Paris. zh 我的童年在巴黎度过。

text_en: I was brought up in Paris so it took a long time to get used to living in London.
text_zh: 我在巴黎长大，所以需要很长时间来熟悉伦敦的生活。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en I was brought up in Paris so it took a long time to get used to living in London. zh 我在巴黎长大，所以需要很长时间来熟悉伦敦的生活。

text_en: I had a very strict upbringing.
text_zh: 我小时候受的教育非常严格。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en I had a very strict upbringing. zh 我小时候受的教育非常严格。

text_en: I graduated from Cambridge University.
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en I graduated from Cambridge University. zh 我毕业于剑桥大学。

text_en: My major is English literature.
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en My major is English literature. zh 我主修英国文学。

text_en: The day I decided to change my career was the big turning-point in my life.
text_zh: 我决定换一种职业的那天是我人生的一个重要转折点。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en The day I decided to change my career was the big turning-point in my life. zh 我决定换一种职业的那天是我人生的一个重要转折点。

text_en: I'll never forget the day I got married. It was the best day of my life.
text_zh: 我永远忘不了结婚那天。那是我这辈子最美好的日子。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en I'll never forget the day I got married. It was the best day of my life. zh 我永远忘不了结婚那天。那是我这辈子最美好的日子。

text_en: Will you still love me when I'm old and grey?
text_zh: 当我老了，头发白了，你是否会一直爱我？
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en Will you still love me when I'm old and grey? zh 当我老了，头发白了，你是否会一直爱我？

text_en: My first marriage unfortunately only lasted a couple of years.
text_zh: 我的第一次婚姻不幸维持了没几年。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en My first marriage unfortunately only lasted a couple of years. zh 我的第一次婚姻不幸维持了没几年。

text_en: I'm self-employed.
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en I'm self-employed. zh 我自己开公司。

text_en: The lowest point in my life was probably when I lost my job at the BBC.
text_zh: 我这辈子最倒霉的时候恐怕就是丢了 BBC 的工作。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en The lowest point in my life was probably when I lost my job at the BBC. zh 我这辈子最倒霉的时候恐怕就是丢了 BBC 的工作。

text_en: When Paul left university he applied for a job in the accounts department of a local engineering company.
text_zh: 保罗大学毕业后在当地一家工程公司的会计部门找到一份工作。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en When Paul left university he applied for a job in the accounts department of a local engineering company. zh 保罗大学毕业后在当地一家工程公司的会计部门找到一份工作。

text_en: His prospect looked good.
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en His prospect looked good. zh 他的事业前途光明。

text_en: By the time he was 30, he decided he wanted a fresh challenge.
text_zh: 岁时，他觉得自己应该寻求一些新的挑战。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en By the time he was 30, he decided he wanted a fresh challenge. zh 岁时，他觉得自己应该寻求一些新的挑战。

text_en: He resigned from his company.
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en He resigned from his company. zh 他辞职了。

text_en: Now that I'm over 40, I can feel middle age approaching.
text_zh: 岁以后，我能感觉到中年在逼近。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en Now that I'm over 40, I can feel middle age approaching. zh 岁以后，我能感觉到中年在逼近。

text_en: I want to stop work when I'm 60 and have a long and happy retirement.
text_zh: 我希望60岁就不用工作了，尽情享受一个悠长快乐的退休时光。
text_for_embedding: topic Stages of Life 人生的阶段 type useful_expression tags en I want to stop work when I'm 60 and have a long and happy retirement. zh 我希望60岁就不用工作了，尽情享受一个悠长快乐的退休时光。

text_en: That sounds like a sensible plan. Do you want me to help you with your job search?
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en That sounds like a sensible plan. Do you want me to help you with your job search? zh 你上司怎么说?
speaker: A

text_en: That's very generous of you. Thanks for the offer.
text_zh: 开始我早上睡过头了，结果上班迟到了两小时。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en That's very generous of you. Thanks for the offer. zh 开始我早上睡过头了，结果上班迟到了两小时。
speaker: E

text_en: Don't mention it. That's what friends are for!
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en Don't mention it. That's what friends are for! zh 出什么事了?
speaker: A

text_en: I don't know what to do about the people who live in the flat above me!
text_zh: 唉，我真是不知道你还能做些什么了。要不试试送点巧克力去收买他们？
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en I don't know what to do about the people who live in the flat above me! zh 唉，我真是不知道你还能做些什么了。要不试试送点巧克力去收买他们？
speaker: E

text_en: Why? What are they like?
text_zh: 我觉得你把这件事看得有点过于乐观了。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en Why? What are they like? zh 我觉得你把这件事看得有点过于乐观了。
speaker: A

text_en: They're incredibly selfish. They're always up until the wee hours of the night playing their music so loudly that I have to wear earplugs in order to fall asleep!
text_zh: 嗯，要不你开个派对，尽量多了解他们。没准你们混熟了，就会好相处一些。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en They're incredibly selfish. They're always up until the wee hours of the night playing their music so loudly that I have to wear earplugs in order to fall asleep! zh 嗯，要不你开个派对，尽量多了解他们。没准你们混熟了，就会好相处一些。
speaker: E

text_en: Have you ever talked to them about it?
text_zh: 现在我可没什么经济能力搬家。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en Have you ever talked to them about it? zh 现在我可没什么经济能力搬家。
speaker: A

text_en: I tried to introduce myself to them when they moved in, but they were so arrogant that I didn't want to ever talk to them again!
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en I tried to introduce myself to them when they moved in, but they were so arrogant that I didn't want to ever talk to them again! zh 也许你该考虑搬走。
speaker: E

text_en: What did they say?
text_zh: 大多数邻居也都不想跟他们打交道。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en What did they say? zh 大多数邻居也都不想跟他们打交道。
speaker: A

text_en: They both just talk about how great they are all the time.
text_zh: 你们这栋公寓里的其他人怎么看他们?
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en They both just talk about how great they are all the time. zh 你们这栋公寓里的其他人怎么看他们?
speaker: E

text_en: They sound like the neighbours from hell!
text_zh: 是没有。但是他们在自己的房间里说话太大声了，我在卧室都能听到。而且总在说人家的坏话。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en They sound like the neighbours from hell! zh 是没有。但是他们在自己的房间里说话太大声了，我在卧室都能听到。而且总在说人家的坏话。
speaker: A

text_en: They are! Besides being loud and arrogant, they're also terrible gossips. They're always talking about everybody else in the apartment.
text_zh: 我以为你没怎么跟他们说过话。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en They are! Besides being loud and arrogant, they're also terrible gossips. They're always talking about everybody else in the apartment. zh 我以为你没怎么跟他们说过话。
speaker: E

text_en: I thought you didn't talk to them much.
text_zh: 没错！除了制造噪音和为人傲慢无礼之外，他们还特别爱说别人的闲话。总在议论这栋公寓里的每一家人。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en I thought you didn't talk to them much. zh 没错！除了制造噪音和为人傲慢无礼之外，他们还特别爱说别人的闲话。总在议论这栋公寓里的每一家人。
speaker: A

text_en: I don't, but they talk so loudly that I can hear what they're talking about from my bedroom—and it's not very nice.
text_zh: 这种邻居好像是最糟糕的。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en I don't, but they talk so loudly that I can hear what they're talking about from my bedroom—and it's not very nice. zh 这种邻居好像是最糟糕的。
speaker: E

text_en: What do the other people in your apartment think about them?
text_zh: 他们总在夸耀自己有多棒。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en What do the other people in your apartment think about them? zh 他们总在夸耀自己有多棒。
speaker: A

text_en: Most of my other neighbours are scared of them.
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en Most of my other neighbours are scared of them. zh 他们说过什么？
speaker: E

text_en: Maybe you should think about moving.
text_zh: 他们刚搬来的时候我试图做自我介绍来着。可是他们特别傲慢无礼，所以我再也不想跟他们说话了。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en Maybe you should think about moving. zh 他们刚搬来的时候我试图做自我介绍来着。可是他们特别傲慢无礼，所以我再也不想跟他们说话了。
speaker: A

text_en: I can't afford to move right now.
text_zh: 你跟他们谈过这个问题吗?
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en I can't afford to move right now. zh 你跟他们谈过这个问题吗?
speaker: E

text_en: Well, perhaps you should have a party and try to get to know them better. Maybe once you get to know them, they'll turn out to be more sensitive.
text_zh: 他们自私的程度简直令人难以相信。比如：总是在夜里把音乐放得很大声，直到凌晨，害得我不得不塞着耳塞才能入睡。
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en Well, perhaps you should have a party and try to get to know them better. Maybe once you get to know them, they'll turn out to be more sensitive. zh 他们自私的程度简直令人难以相信。比如：总是在夜里把音乐放得很大声，直到凌晨，害得我不得不塞着耳塞才能入睡。
speaker: A

text_en: I think you're being a bit optimistic. If you met them, you'd understand.
text_zh: 怎么了？他们是什么样的人？
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en I think you're being a bit optimistic. If you met them, you'd understand. zh 怎么了？他们是什么样的人？
speaker: E

text_en: Well, I don't know what else you could do then. Do you think bribing them with chocolate would work?
text_zh: 我真不知道该拿住楼上的那户人怎么办!
text_for_embedding: topic Getting Personal 个性特征 type dialogue_turn tags en Well, I don't know what else you could do then. Do you think bribing them with chocolate would work? zh 我真不知道该拿住楼上的那户人怎么办!
speaker: A

text_en: In North America, people who are facing each other generally want about three feet of space in front of them.

text_en: To have and to hold from this day forward, for better, for worse, for richer, for poorer, in sickness and in health, to love and to cherish, till death do us part.

1It's quite a rough area. My house has been burgled three times since I've been there.这地方的治安实在是太糟了。我们家搬来之后已经失窃三次了。
2This place is thoroughly boring. / This place is dead.这地方没劲透了。
3There are a lot of bars and clubs. It's got a great night life.附近有很多酒吧和俱乐部。夜生活丰富多彩。
4It's quite a posh area.这是个富人区。
5It's very convenient for the shops.购物很方便。
6There's a lot of crime and prostitution round there.这是个犯罪事件和卖淫活动的多发地段。
7There's only one park in the whole neighbourhood.整个居民区只有一个公园。
8She lives in a quiet suburb area of Los Angeles.她住在洛城郊外一个很安静的地方。
9The fire department will be there right away.消防队马上就到。
10Sue wants to be on a bus line.苏想住在公共汽车站附近。
11It's on a noisy street and it's a little far from the supermarket.这条街很吵,而且离超市有点远。
12The area is very nice and the neighbours seem friendly.这个地区不错,邻居们也很友善。
13This house offers a beautiful setting.这套房子环境优美。
14It's incredibly central.它在城市的正中心。
15I'm looking for a small house that isn't too far from the station.我想找个离火车站不太远的小房子。
16Many people don't understand the problems related to the water system.有关供水体系的问题很多人都弄不明白。
17It's easy to get out of the city, and some of the surrounding countryside is beautiful.想离开城市的喧嚣很简单,郊外总有美景。

1 I'm just browsing, thanks.我只是随便看看,谢谢。
2 Show me this one, please.请拿这个给我看看。
3 Oh, that suits you very well.哇,很适合你!
4 Ok, I'll take it.好的,我要了。
5 It was on special offer.这个在特惠期。
6 Have you got it in medium.这件有中号的吗?
7 What make is it?什么牌子的?
8 Shop till you drop!逛死为止!
9 They're cheap and cheerful.这些东西物美价廉。
10 Have you got it in white?这款有白色的吗?
11 It must cost you a packet. /It must have cost a fortune.这个一定花了你一大笔钱。
12 The flights are a bit pricey at this time of the year.每年的这个时候机票都会比较贵。
13 It was a real bargain! I got this Beatles CD in the second-hand shop for a pound.我赚了!这张甲壳虫乐队的CD在二手店才卖1英镑。
14 It didn't cost me a penny. My brother gave it to me.这是白来的,我哥哥给我的。
15 We had to get tickets at the last minute so we had to pay through the nose for them.起飞前我们才买到票,被狠狠地敲了一笔。
16 It was a real rip-off.真黑啊,简直像抢钱一样。
17 All out now. Please come earlier tomorrow.全卖光了,明天请早点来。
18 You get a chance like this only once in a blue moon.这可是个千载难逢的好机会。

text_en: It's such a nice day outside. Let's take a walk into town and do some window-shopping.
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en It's such a nice day outside. Let's take a walk into town and do some window-shopping. zh
speaker: Alyssa

text_en: You know I hate shopping more than anything else in this world.
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en You know I hate shopping more than anything else in this world. zh
speaker: Connor

text_en: I know. But we could get some exercise in, and we could get some errands run, too. Window-shopping won't cost you anything.
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en I know. But we could get some exercise in, and we could get some errands run, too. Window-shopping won't cost you anything. zh 我早该想到的……
speaker: A

text_en: What kind of errands do we need to run?
text_zh: 我答应不进购物中心，可是我还要去市场逛逛。
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en What kind of errands do we need to run? zh 我答应不进购物中心，可是我还要去市场逛逛。
speaker: C

text_en: Well, we could go to the newsagent's to pick up the Sunday paper, go to the butcher's to pick up a chicken for a roast dinner, and to the chemist's to pick up your prescription from the doctor.
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en Well, we could go to the newsagent's to pick up the Sunday paper, go to the butcher's to pick up a chicken for a roast dinner, and to the chemist's to pick up your prescription from the doctor. zh 你说过你只逛不买的!
speaker: A

text_en: I'll only go if we can stop at the off-license to pick up something to drink for tonight.
text_zh: 办那几件事用啊。而且可能还额外需要一点儿在街上自动售货机买东西用。
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en I'll only go if we can stop at the off-license to pick up something to drink for tonight. zh 办那几件事用啊。而且可能还额外需要一点儿在街上自动售货机买东西用。
speaker: C

text_en: Fine, we'll do that on the way home, so we don't have to carry it the whole time.
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en Fine, we'll do that on the way home, so we don't have to carry it the whole time. zh 干什么用的?
speaker: A

text_en: Sounds good. You have to promise not to go into any of the stores in the mall though. I know how you like to try things on in the fitting rooms, especially if the stores have special offers.
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en Sounds good. You have to promise not to go into any of the stores in the mall though. I know how you like to try things on in the fitting rooms, especially if the stores have special offers. zh 你身上有钱吗?
speaker: C

text_en: I promise. We're only going for a walk to get some exercise and to get some things done that we haven't had time for.
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en I promise. We're only going for a walk to get some exercise and to get some things done that we haven't had time for. zh 好吧，现在出发！
speaker: A

text_en: OK, let's go then!
text_zh: 我答应你。我们就是出门走走当锻炼身体，然后再把那几件平常没时间办的事情办好。
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en OK, let's go then! zh 我答应你。我们就是出门走走当锻炼身体，然后再把那几件平常没时间办的事情办好。
speaker: C

text_en: Do you have any money?
text_zh: 听起来还不错。但是你得答应我不进到购物中心的任何一家店。我可知道你有多喜
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en Do you have any money? zh 听起来还不错。但是你得答应我不进到购物中心的任何一家店。我可知道你有多喜
speaker: A

text_en: For what?
text_zh: 好吧，咱们回来的路上去买，这样我们就不用一路上都提着它了。
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en For what? zh 好吧，咱们回来的路上去买，这样我们就不用一路上都提着它了。
speaker: C

text_en: For our errands, and maybe a little extra for something from a vendor on the street.
text_zh: 如果能去酒店买几瓶今晚喝的东西，我才会去。
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en For our errands, and maybe a little extra for something from a vendor on the street. zh 如果能去酒店买几瓶今晚喝的东西，我才会去。
speaker: A

text_en: You said you were only going to window shop!
text_zh: 嗯，咱们得去报摊买一份周日的报纸，去肉铺买点晚餐烧烤用的鸡肉，还得去药房取医生给你开的处方。
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en You said you were only going to window shop! zh 嗯，咱们得去报摊买一份周日的报纸，去肉铺买点晚餐烧烤用的鸡肉，还得去药房取医生给你开的处方。
speaker: C

text_en: I agreed to not go into the mall, but I can still look at things in the market!
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en I agreed to not go into the mall, but I can still look at things in the market! zh 咱们有什么事情要办?
speaker: A

text_en: I should have known...
text_zh: 我知道。可是我们还能锻炼身体呢，而且还有点任务。逛逛街又不会花费你什么。
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en I should have known... zh 我知道。可是我们还能锻炼身体呢，而且还有点任务。逛逛街又不会花费你什么。
speaker: C

text_en: What do you think about this store? I heard it's a posh store that's only got branches in big cities.

text_en: I love this store! The only problem is that it's extremely expensive.
text_zh: 我真是太走运了。太阳简直是从西边出来了！谢谢，亲爱的！
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en I love this store! The only problem is that it's extremely expensive. zh 我真是太走运了。太阳简直是从西边出来了！谢谢，亲爱的！

text_en: Don't worry. I've decided that for your birthday I'm going to take you shopping for a new dress.
text_zh: 我觉得你看起来美极了。生日快乐！
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en Don't worry. I've decided that for your birthday I'm going to take you shopping for a new dress. zh 我觉得你看起来美极了。生日快乐！
speaker: C

text_en: Really? I thought you hated shopping?
text_zh: 真是太棒了！你觉得怎么样？
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en Really? I thought you hated shopping? zh 真是太棒了！你觉得怎么样？
speaker: A

text_en: I do, that's why you should appreciate this gift!
text_zh: 我觉得这个颜色不是太适合我。这款有白色的吗？
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en I do, that's why you should appreciate this gift! zh 我觉得这个颜色不是太适合我。这款有白色的吗？
speaker: C

text_en: Sure. That's really nice of you. Let's go in and try some things on.
text_zh: 给你。要是别的日子，这件会花掉我不少钱，不过今天是特价。
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en Sure. That's really nice of you. Let's go in and try some things on. zh 给你。要是别的日子，这件会花掉我不少钱，不过今天是特价。
speaker: A

text_en: How about this red dress? I think it would really suit you.
text_zh: 真是太漂亮了！这个有8号的吗？
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en How about this red dress? I think it would really suit you. zh 真是太漂亮了！这个有8号的吗？
speaker: C

text_en: That's gorgeous! Do they have it in a size 8?
text_zh: 这条红裙子怎么样？我觉得它特别适合你。

speaker: A

text_en: Here you go. On any other day, it would cost me a fortune, but it's on special offer today.
text_zh: 我当然会的。你真是太好了。咱们进去试穿几件吧。
text_for_embedding: topic Shopping 购物 type dialogue_turn tags shopping en Here you go. On any other day, it would cost me a fortune, but it's on special offer today. zh 我当然会的。你真是太好了。咱们进去试穿几件吧。

text_en: I think this colour isn't quite right for me. Do they have the same dress in white?
text_zh: 我是讨厌。所以你该特别珍惜这件礼物！

text_en: This is perfect! What do you think?
text_zh: 别担心。我已经想好了，为了给你庆祝生日，我带你逛街给你买条新裙子。

text_en:
1Money makes us greedy.金钱让人产生贪欲。
2After we deduct taxes, the net profit will be a lot less than the gross profit.扣税之后,净利润会比毛利润少很多。
3The antique watch is worth a lot of money.这块古董表很值钱。
4Here's the phone bill.这是电话费通知单。
5When is this due?交费截止到什么时候?
6Sorry, I'm broke. / I'm flat broke对不起,我现在身无分文。
7I have a lot of money on me now.现在我能有很多现金。
8I'm rolling in it.我现在很有钱。
9I can't afford to be lazy.我可没有时间闲呆着。
10How wasteful!多浪费呀!
11He didn't pay the debt and disappeared. /He skipped town without paying his debt.他因为还不上债而躲了起来。
12It's very hard to earn a living these days.最近赚钱很不容易。
13What do you think are the best ways to save or invest money?你觉得省钱或者投资的最好方法是什么?
14Some people become rich by winning the lottery or playing the stock market.有些人有钱是因为中了彩票或者炒股票赚了一笔。
15Money is still a major incentive in most occupations.在许多职业中,钱仍然是主要的激励因素。
16There should be a single currency for the whole world.全球应该只流通一种货币。
17It might be hard to make ends meet if you lose your job.如果你丢了工作,那恐怕很难维持收支平衡。

text_en: I'd like to open a new account.

1Write and let me know how you're getting on.写信告诉我你的近况。
2You can apply for a new passport by post.你可以通过邮寄申请一本护照。
3Where would you like to send it?您想往哪儿寄?
4I wrote her several letters, but she never wrote back.我给她写了很多封信,可是她一封都没回过。
5That's 500 grams.这个重500克。
6Airmail is much faster.航空邮寄要快很多。
7Which counter should I go to?我应该去哪个柜台?
8I'd like to send it as a registered parcel.我想寄一个挂号包裹。
9Please fill in the order form.请您填张汇款单。
10What's the surcharge on this express parcel?这个快递包裹的额外邮资是多少?
11Can I send these records as printed matter?我能不能把这些唱片当成印刷品邮寄?
12Could you put it on the scales, so I can check the weight?你把它放到秤上好吗,我好称一称重量。
13I suppose airmail is faster and more expensive than surface mail.我想航空邮件应该比平邮更快,当然也更贵一些吧。
14Post offices are still the place to go to collect welfare benefits.邮局还是领救济金的地方。
15How can I check if the parcel has arrived?我怎么查包裹到了没有呢?
16It's a little overweight. You have to pay extra.有点超重了,您得付超重费。
17Be sure to put down the address of the receiver clearly.注意要把收件人写清楚。
18We need your signature here.我们需要您的签名。
19It's much better if you stick the stamps on the package.如果你把邮票贴在包裹上就更好了。
20Please endorse it first.请您先签收。
21I'd like to wire some money to my mom in London.我想给我在伦敦的母亲电汇一些钱。
22Please insure it for £ 10.请为它买10英镑的保险。
23Please write that postal order in block letters.请用印刷体填写那张邮局汇票。

text_en: Excuse me, could you tell me which line I'm supposed to stand in to buy bubble wrap and to post a package?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Excuse me, could you tell me which line I'm supposed to stand in to buy bubble wrap and to post a package? zh
speaker: Grace

text_en: You can buy the bubble wrap here, but you'll have to stand in line over there to post your package.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en You can buy the bubble wrap here, but you'll have to stand in line over there to post your package. zh
speaker: Alexander

text_en: That's a really long line. How long do you think it'll take to get through all those people?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en That's a really long line. How long do you think it'll take to get through all those people? zh
speaker: G

text_en: It takes about 3 minutes per person, so it'll probably be about an hour's wait.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en It takes about 3 minutes per person, so it'll probably be about an hour's wait. zh
speaker: A

text_en: Can I buy stamps here?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Can I buy stamps here? zh
speaker: G

text_en: Sure. How many would you like?
text_zh: 还要额外再加 1 英镑。
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Sure. How many would you like? zh 还要额外再加 1 英镑。
speaker: A

text_en: I need 30 for my Christmas cards.
text_zh: 气泡衬垫包装纸是多少钱?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en I need 30 for my Christmas cards. zh 气泡衬垫包装纸是多少钱?
speaker: G

text_en: Are you sending them abroad?
text_zh: 好的，给你。一共是 18 英镑 72 便士。
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Are you sending them abroad? zh 好的，给你。一共是 18 英镑 72 便士。
speaker: A

text_en: Twenty of them are going abroad to China and America.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Twenty of them are going abroad to China and America. zh 没有。
speaker: G

text_en: Do you have any going anywhere in the EU? If you do, those are less expensive.
text_zh: 有没有寄到欧洲去的？如果有寄到那边的，邮资没那么贵。
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Do you have any going anywhere in the EU? If you do, those are less expensive. zh 有没有寄到欧洲去的？如果有寄到那边的，邮资没那么贵。
speaker: A

text_en: No.
text_zh: 其中有 20 张是寄到中国和美国的。
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en No. zh 其中有 20 张是寄到中国和美国的。
speaker: G

text_en: OK, here you go. That will be 18 pounds and seventy two pence.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en OK, here you go. That will be 18 pounds and seventy two pence. zh 都是寄到国外去的吗?
speaker: A

text_en: And the bubble wrap?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en And the bubble wrap? zh 没错。要买多少？
speaker: G

text_en: That's another quid.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en That's another quid. zh 邮票是在这儿买吗?
speaker: A

text_en: Thanks a lot. You've been very helpful.
text_zh: 每个人大概要三分钟左右，所以您得等一个小时。
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Thanks a lot. You've been very helpful. zh 每个人大概要三分钟左右，所以您得等一个小时。
speaker: G

text_en: How can I help you?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en How can I help you? zh
speaker: A

text_en: I'd like to send this package to China.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en I'd like to send this package to China. zh
speaker: G

text_en: Would you like to send it surface or airmail?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Would you like to send it surface or airmail? zh 不用谢。
speaker: A

text_en: What's the difference between surface and airmail?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en What's the difference between surface and airmail? zh 好的。谢谢你。
speaker: G

text_en: If you send the parcel with surface mail, it will take about 2 months to arrive, whereas with airmail, it will arrive in 7-10 days.
text_zh: 写吧，最好写上。如果包裹没有寄到收信的地址，还能寄回给发信人。
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en If you send the parcel with surface mail, it will take about 2 months to arrive, whereas with airmail, it will arrive in 7-10 days. zh 写吧，最好写上。如果包裹没有寄到收信的地址，还能寄回给发信人。
speaker: A

text_en: That's a big difference. I suppose airmail will be much more expensive.
text_zh: 好了。我需要在包装上写回邮地址吗？
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en That's a big difference. I suppose airmail will be much more expensive. zh 好了。我需要在包装上写回邮地址吗？
speaker: G

text_en: That depends on the weight.
text_zh: 您只需要把这个客户表格填好。写的时候多用点力，才能保证填的内容三张复写单子上都能看清楚。
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en That depends on the weight. zh 您只需要把这个客户表格填好。写的时候多用点力，才能保证填的内容三张复写单子上都能看清楚。
speaker: A

text_en: How much will it cost to send it airmail?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en How much will it cost to send it airmail? zh 好的。
speaker: G

text_en: Place it on the scale, please.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Place it on the scale, please. zh 单算的。再加 50 便士。
speaker: A

text_en: OK.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en OK. zh 500 克。空邮要 10 英镑。
speaker: G

text_en: That's 500 grams. It will cost 10 pounds for airmail.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en That's 500 grams. It will cost 10 pounds for airmail. zh 好的。
speaker: A

text_en: That's not bad. I'll do that then. Does that include insurance on the contents of the parcel or is that a separate fee?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en That's not bad. I'll do that then. Does that include insurance on the contents of the parcel or is that a separate fee? zh 请把包裹放在秤上。
speaker: G

text_en: That's separate. It's another 50 p.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en That's separate. It's another 50 p. zh 用空邮寄要多少钱?
speaker: A

text_en: OK.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en OK. zh 价钱是按重量计算的。
speaker: G

text_en: Just fill in this customs form. Make sure you press hard so that the information transfers to all three papers.
text_zh: 如果您用平邮寄包裹，大概需要 2 个月左右到；空邮的话，7-10 天就能到。
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Just fill in this customs form. Make sure you press hard so that the information transfers to all three papers. zh 如果您用平邮寄包裹，大概需要 2 个月左右到；空邮的话，7-10 天就能到。
speaker: A

text_en: Alright. Do I need to put a return address on the package?
text_zh: 平邮和空邮有什么区别?
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Alright. Do I need to put a return address on the package? zh 平邮和空邮有什么区别?
speaker: G

text_en: Yes, that would be ideal. If the package doesn't make it to the recipient's address, then it will be sent back to the sender.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en Yes, that would be ideal. If the package doesn't make it to the recipient's address, then it will be sent back to the sender. zh 您想平邮还是航空？
speaker: A

text_en: OK. Thank you very much.
text_zh: 我想把这个包裹寄到中国去。
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en OK. Thank you very much. zh 我想把这个包裹寄到中国去。
speaker: G

text_en: You're welcome.
text_for_embedding: topic At the Post Office 在邮局 type dialogue_turn tags post_office en You're welcome. zh 我可以帮您什么？
speaker: A

text_zh: I'll have your temperature taken. 我一会儿给你量量体温。

text_zh: Let me feel your pulse. 让我给你把把脉。

text_en: You must be hospitalized right now. 你必须马上住院。
text_zh: I'll give you an injection first. 我先来给你打一针。
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type useful_expression tags en You must be hospitalized right now. 你必须马上住院。 zh I'll give you an injection first. 我先来给你打一针。

text_en: Hi Benjamin. My name is Dr. Green. What seems to be the matter?
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Hi Benjamin. My name is Dr. Green. What seems to be the matter? zh
speaker: Mia

text_en: I've been feeling pretty ill for a few days now.
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en I've been feeling pretty ill for a few days now. zh
speaker: Benjamin

text_en: What are you symptoms?
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en What are you symptoms? zh
speaker: M

text_en: I feel chilly, I've got cramps, I keep throwing up, and I feel dizzy and tired.
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en I feel chilly, I've got cramps, I keep throwing up, and I feel dizzy and tired. zh
speaker: B

text_en: It sounds like you might be a bit dehydrated. Do you feel thirsty most of the day?
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en It sounds like you might be a bit dehydrated. Do you feel thirsty most of the day? zh 谢谢。
speaker: M

text_en: Yes. I can't seem to drink enough.
text_zh: 没了，但是我女朋友有传染性单核细胞增多症（mono）。
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes. I can't seem to drink enough. zh 没了，但是我女朋友有传染性单核细胞增多症（mono）。
speaker: B

text_en: Have you been drinking plenty of water?
text_zh: 你家里还有别人生病吗?
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Have you been drinking plenty of water? zh 你家里还有别人生病吗?
speaker: M

text_en: No, just soda.
text_zh: 好像有点低，但是生病的时候这个值也还算正常。
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en No, just soda. zh 好像有点低，但是生病的时候这个值也还算正常。
speaker: B

text_en: Ok. Well, we'll have a nurse take some blood in a few minutes to see if you're dehydrated. First, let me feel your pulse.
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Ok. Well, we'll have a nurse take some blood in a few minutes to see if you're dehydrated. First, let me feel your pulse. zh 不，只是喝些苏打水。
speaker: M

text_en: That seems to be a bit low, but that's not uncommon when you're ill.
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en That seems to be a bit low, but that's not uncommon when you're ill. zh 是喝很多的白开水吗?
speaker: B

text_en: Is anyone else sick in your home?
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Is anyone else sick in your home? zh 渴。我好像喝水不够。
speaker: M

text_en: No, but my girlfriend has mono.
text_zh: 听起来你好像是有点脱水。你一天下来觉得口渴吗？
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en No, but my girlfriend has mono. zh 听起来你好像是有点脱水。你一天下来觉得口渴吗？
speaker: B

text_en: I see. I'll have the lab techs run some tests to check for mono as well then. The nurse will come in then to take your blood, we'll run some tests, and then you can go home. You should hear from us by this afternoon.
text_zh: 我觉得浑身发冷，喘不过气，总想吐，而且又晕又累。
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en I see. I'll have the lab techs run some tests to check for mono as well then. The nurse will come in then to take your blood, we'll run some tests, and then you can go home. You should hear from us by this afternoon. zh 我觉得浑身发冷，喘不过气，总想吐，而且又晕又累。
speaker: M

text_en: Thanks.
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Thanks. zh 都有哪些症状?
speaker: B

text_en: Hi, I'm here to pick up some medicine.
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Hi, I'm here to pick up some medicine. zh
speaker: B

text_en: Do you have the prescription with you?
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Do you have the prescription with you? zh
speaker: M

text_en: Yes, let me see ... here it is.
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes, let me see ... here it is. zh 不用谢!
speaker: B

text_en: Ok, so that's one prescription for some antibiotics, is that right?
text_zh: 行，我到时候再过来。谢谢！
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Ok, so that's one prescription for some antibiotics, is that right? zh 行，我到时候再过来。谢谢！
speaker: M

text_en: Yes. It should be two weeks worth.
text_zh: 好的。我会给你的医生打电话把处方分一下类。大概下午4点钟能弄好。
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes. It should be two weeks worth. zh 好的。我会给你的医生打电话把处方分一下类。大概下午4点钟能弄好。
speaker: B

text_en: Hmm ... it only says one week here. Would you like me to call the doctor to confirm?
text_zh: 没关系，我可以都装在背包里。
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Hmm ... it only says one week here. Would you like me to call the doctor to confirm? zh 没关系，我可以都装在背包里。
speaker: M

text_en: Yes. That would be great. I'm sure she said I'd have to take the medicine for two weeks.
text_zh: 应该是 15.75 美元。要把药都装在一个袋子里吗？
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes. That would be great. I'm sure she said I'd have to take the medicine for two weeks. zh 应该是 15.75 美元。要把药都装在一个袋子里吗？
speaker: B

text_en: OK. You'll have to come back in 30 minutes for that. Do you need anything else?
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en OK. You'll have to come back in 30 minutes for that. Do you need anything else? zh 一共是多少钱?
speaker: M

text_en: Yes, I need some burn ointment, gauze, and some aspirin.
text_zh: 按照共付比率你只需要交 5 美元的抗生素药钱。
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes, I need some burn ointment, gauze, and some aspirin. zh 按照共付比率你只需要交 5 美元的抗生素药钱。
speaker: B

text_en: Ok. Here you go. Do you want to pay for that all right now?
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Ok. Here you go. Do you want to pay for that all right now? zh 有，这是我的保险卡。
speaker: M

text_en: Yes, I might as well.
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes, I might as well. zh 你有保险吗?
speaker: B

text_en: Do you have insurance?
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Do you have insurance? zh 是的，可以。
speaker: M

text_en: Yes. Here's my card.
text_zh: 好了，都在这儿。你可以现在付款吗？
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes. Here's my card. zh 好了，都在这儿。你可以现在付款吗？
speaker: B

text_en: You'll just have to pay a $5 co-payment for the antibiotic prescription then.
text_zh: 好了。30 分钟之后你可以回来取药。还需要其他什么吗？
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en You'll just have to pay a $5 co-payment for the antibiotic prescription then. zh 好了。30 分钟之后你可以回来取药。还需要其他什么吗？
speaker: M

text_en: How much is it all together?
text_zh: 嗯……这上面写着只是一个星期的。我可以给你的医生打电话确认一下吗？
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en How much is it all together? zh 嗯……这上面写着只是一个星期的。我可以给你的医生打电话确认一下吗？
speaker: B

text_en: That will be $ 15.75. Would you like it all in a bag?
text_zh: 是，大概是两个星期的药。
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en That will be $ 15.75. Would you like it all in a bag? zh 是，大概是两个星期的药。
speaker: M

text_en: That's ok. I'll just put it all in my back pack.
text_zh: 好的，开的是一些抗生素类的药，对吗？
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en That's ok. I'll just put it all in my back pack. zh 好的，开的是一些抗生素类的药，对吗？
speaker: B

text_en: OK. I'll give your doctor a call and sort out the prescription. It should be ready for you by 4:00 pm.
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en OK. I'll give your doctor a call and sort out the prescription. It should be ready for you by 4:00 pm. zh 带了，等我找找……在这儿。
speaker: M

text_en: OK, I'll stop by then. Thanks!
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en OK, I'll stop by then. Thanks! zh 你带药方了吗?
speaker: B

text_en: You're welcome!
text_for_embedding: topic Illness and Disease 疾病 type dialogue_turn tags en You're welcome! zh 你好，我来取药。
speaker: M

text_en: Lots of fresh fruit and vegetables will help you to keep healthy.
text_zh: 很多新鲜的蔬菜水果都有益身体健康。
text_for_embedding: topic Healthy Food 健康食品 type useful_expression tags en Lots of fresh fruit and vegetables will help you to keep healthy. zh 很多新鲜的蔬菜水果都有益身体健康。

text_en: It's not essential to give up alcohol completely. Some doctors think a little a day is actually good for you.
text_zh: 不用滴酒不沾。有些医生认为每天喝一点酒对健康有益。
text_for_embedding: topic Healthy Food 健康食品 type useful_expression tags en It's not essential to give up alcohol completely. Some doctors think a little a day is actually good for you. zh 不用滴酒不沾。有些医生认为每天喝一点酒对健康有益。

text_en: Eat small meals regularly.
text_for_embedding: topic Healthy Food 健康食品 type useful_expression tags en Eat small meals regularly. zh 要有规律地少吃多餐。

text_en: Judy goes on a diet to keep fit.
text_for_embedding: topic Healthy Food 健康食品 type useful_expression tags en Judy goes on a diet to keep fit. zh 朱迪在节食减肥。

text_en: Personally, I prefer soya-bean milk to evaporated milk.
text_zh: 就我个人而言，跟脱脂牛奶相比我还是更喜欢喝豆浆。
text_for_embedding: topic Healthy Food 健康食品 type useful_expression tags en Personally, I prefer soya-bean milk to evaporated milk. zh 就我个人而言，跟脱脂牛奶相比我还是更喜欢喝豆浆。

text_for_embedding: topic Healthy Food 健康食品 type useful_expression tags en Would you like some cereal for breakfast? zh 你早餐想吃一点麦片吗？

text_en: Some very thin teenage girls don't eat because they think they're fat.
text_zh: 很多十几岁的很瘦的女孩总是觉得自己胖，所以饿着不吃饭。
text_for_embedding: topic Healthy Food 健康食品 type useful_expression tags en Some very thin teenage girls don't eat because they think they're fat. zh 很多十几岁的很瘦的女孩总是觉得自己胖，所以饿着不吃饭。

text_en: A diet containing lots of fruit and vegetables helps reduce cancer.
text_zh: 含有大量蔬菜和水果的膳食有利于防癌。
text_for_embedding: topic Healthy Food 健康食品 type useful_expression tags en A diet containing lots of fruit and vegetables helps reduce cancer. zh 含有大量蔬菜和水果的膳食有利于防癌。

text_en: If you want to keep fit, try some diet coke.
text_zh: 如果想减肥就试试喝低卡可乐。

text_en: What places would you recommend a visitor to go to in your country?
text_zh: 对于一个来旅游的人你会建议他去你们国家的哪些地方玩？

text_zh: 很多美丽的城市成为观光地点。

text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type useful_expression tags en New York is very cosmopolitan. zh 纽约容纳了全世界各地的人和文化。

text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type useful_expression tags en I fancy a few days in Tibet this summer. zh 我一直在设想着今年夏天能去西藏待一阵儿。

text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type useful_expression tags en I want to go to a lively resort where the night-life is good. zh 我想去个夜生活丰富、富有活力的地方度假。

text_en: We spent the afternoon walking around Venice, seeing all the sights.

text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type useful_expression tags en We spent the afternoon walking around Venice, seeing all the sights. zh 我们下午逛了逛威尼斯，看了所有的名胜。

text_zh: 这次旅行之后，我已经对观光旅游有点腻了。
text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type useful_expression tags en By this time, I was sick of sightseeing. zh 这次旅行之后，我已经对观光旅游有点腻了。

speaker: Taylor

speaker: E

text_en: I went a long time ago, before they built the new train that can take you there.

speaker: T

text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en Personally, I think it'd be better to go when you have more time. A few days isn't really enough to get acclimatize yourself and to go on a few excursions outside of the capital. zh
speaker: T

speaker: E

text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en It's a beautiful city, but I think it's become too touristy. How about going to a cosmopolitan city like Shanghai or Hong Kong? zh 我觉得如果只有几天时间的话，我很可能会考虑去一些不太远的地方。
speaker: T

text_en: I'd like to get away from the big city life.
text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en I'd like to get away from the big city life. zh 我想远离都市生活。
speaker: E

text_zh: 你说得很有道理。你觉得阳朔怎么样？
text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en Maybe you should consider going to a hot springs resort outside of Beijing. I heard they are very relaxing. zh 你说得很有道理。你觉得阳朔怎么样？
speaker: T

text_zh: 你觉得去那儿待几天好吗？
text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en I guess if I only have a few days, I should probably think about going somewhere that isn't too far away. zh 你觉得去那儿待几天好吗？
speaker: E

text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en Thanks; I'll give them a call later. zh 你想去哪儿?
speaker: E

text_en: Welcome back! How was your vacation?
text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en Welcome back! How was your vacation? zh
speaker: E

text_en: It was fantastic, but I'm glad to be back! Being a tourist is really tiring!
text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en It was fantastic, but I'm glad to be back! Being a tourist is really tiring! zh

speaker: E

text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en That was the first thing we did. I have a few pictures. Do you want to see them? zh
speaker: T

text_en: No, by that time, I was sick of sightseeing. I had had enough of art galleries, cathedrals, fountains, statues, and palaces!
text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en No, by that time, I was sick of sightseeing. I had had enough of art galleries, cathedrals, fountains, statues, and palaces! zh 那你怎么办？

text_en: So what did you do?
text_zh: 你看起来不怎么高兴啊。
text_for_embedding: topic City Sightseeing 城市观光 type dialogue_turn tags en So what did you do? zh 你看起来不怎么高兴啊。

text_zh: 我不能误了十点那趟火车。

text_en: I'm going to London on business.
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en I'm going to London on business. zh 我要去伦敦出差。

text_en: Nothing is more stressful than going on a business trip with our boss.
text_zh: 没有比跟老板一起出差更让人紧张的了。
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en Nothing is more stressful than going on a business trip with our boss. zh 没有比跟老板一起出差更让人紧张的了。

text_en: They scheduled the negotiation at nine tomorrow morning.
text_zh: 他们安排明早九点谈判。
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en They scheduled the negotiation at nine tomorrow morning. zh 他们安排明早九点谈判。

text_en: Don't you think it'd be a good thing for you to get out of the office for a couple of days?
text_zh: 你觉不觉得远离办公室歇几天是件不错的事？
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en Don't you think it'd be a good thing for you to get out of the office for a couple of days? zh 你觉不觉得远离办公室歇几天是件不错的事？

text_en: The train hasn't been crowded at all recently.
text_zh: 最近火车一点儿都不挤。
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en The train hasn't been crowded at all recently. zh 最近火车一点儿都不挤。

text_en: Last time I went on a business trip with the boss. I didn't even have enough to eat.
text_zh: 上次我跟老板出差连饭都吃不饱。
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en Last time I went on a business trip with the boss. I didn't even have enough to eat. zh 上次我跟老板出差连饭都吃不饱。

text_en: The first thing you'll do is look for a comfortable hotel.
text_zh: 首先你得选一家舒服的旅馆。
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en The first thing you'll do is look for a comfortable hotel. zh 首先你得选一家舒服的旅馆。

text_en: You don't know how tight the schedule is for this business trip.
text_zh: 你不知道这次出差的日程安排有多满。
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en You don't know how tight the schedule is for this business trip. zh 你不知道这次出差的日程安排有多满。

text_en: Nothing's been decided yet. Why is everyone in such a hurry to go?
text_zh: 什么事都没定好呢，干嘛要那么急着去呢？
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en Nothing's been decided yet. Why is everyone in such a hurry to go? zh 什么事都没定好呢，干嘛要那么急着去呢？

text_en: The company is sometimes very cheap with the travel expenses.

text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en The company is sometimes very cheap with the travel expenses. zh 这家公司在差旅费上的预算很少。

text_en: I like to take an occasional business trip.
text_zh: 我喜欢偶尔有些出差的机会。
text_for_embedding: topic Business Trip 商务旅行 type useful_expression tags en I like to take an occasional business trip. zh 我喜欢偶尔有些出差的机会。

text_en: On this trip I have to visit several important customers.

text_zh: 每次出差回来，我都得写一份详细的报告。

text_en: Which form of transport do you prefer to use?
text_zh: 你喜欢采用什么样的交通方式？
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en Which form of transport do you prefer to use? zh 你喜欢采用什么样的交通方式？

text_en: Compared with cars, bicycles have the advantage of giving off no pollution.
text_zh: 和汽车相比，自行车的优势是不污染环境。
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en Compared with cars, bicycles have the advantage of giving off no pollution. zh 和汽车相比，自行车的优势是不污染环境。

text_en: Rather than ride on a crowded bus, he always prefers to ride a bicycle.
text_zh: 与其乘坐拥挤的公共汽车，他倒总是更愿意骑自行车。
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en Rather than ride on a crowded bus, he always prefers to ride a bicycle. zh 与其乘坐拥挤的公共汽车，他倒总是更愿意骑自行车。

text_en: I feel that I can see more when I pedal a bicycle.
text_zh: 我觉得骑自行车可以看到更多风景。
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en I feel that I can see more when I pedal a bicycle. zh 我觉得骑自行车可以看到更多风景。

text_en: I think we should discourage people from using their private cars.
text_zh: 我觉得我们应该说服人们尽量少用私家车。
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en I think we should discourage people from using their private cars. zh 我觉得我们应该说服人们尽量少用私家车。

text_en: Cycling is good for our environment.
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en Cycling is good for our environment. zh 骑自行车对环境有利。

text_en: More people are taking to their bikes because they are being encouraged to lead healthier lifestyles.
text_zh: 越来越多的人迷上了骑自行车，因为这是被鼓励采用的一种健康生活方式。
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en More people are taking to their bikes because they are being encouraged to lead healthier lifestyles. zh 越来越多的人迷上了骑自行车，因为这是被鼓励采用的一种健康生活方式。

text_en: You don't have to wear cycling shorts with a pointy helmet. Rounded helmets are better.
text_zh: 您不必戴尖头头盔来配骑车专用的短裤，圆形的头盔更好。
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en You don't have to wear cycling shorts with a pointy helmet. Rounded helmets are better. zh 您不必戴尖头头盔来配骑车专用的短裤，圆形的头盔更好。

text_en: The routes seem to twist and turn rather than going roughly in a straight line.
text_zh: 路线蜿蜒曲折，不是一条直线。
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en The routes seem to twist and turn rather than going roughly in a straight line. zh 路线蜿蜒曲折，不是一条直线。

text_en: You should ride along the bicycle lane.
text_zh: 你应该沿着自行车道骑。
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en You should ride along the bicycle lane. zh 你应该沿着自行车道骑。

text_en: Why don't we go there by bike? We could face delay if we travel by bus.
text_zh: 为什么咱们不骑自行车去那儿呢？要是坐公共汽车的话一定会迟到的。
text_for_embedding: topic Cycling 骑行 type useful_expression tags en Why don't we go there by bike? We could face delay if we travel by bus. zh 为什么咱们不骑自行车去那儿呢？要是坐公共汽车的话一定会迟到的。

text_en: On my way home, my tire got a hole in it and I didn't have a pump, so I had to walk.

1I've got no sense of direction!我没什么方向感!
2Ask this lady here.问问这位女士。
3Where do I get off to go to the Golden Gate Bridge?去金门大桥在哪站下车?
4Are we there yet?我们还没到吗?
5How many more stops are there before Bath?还有几站到巴斯?
6Follow the sign to the city centre.跟着路标走就能到市中心了。
7Have we passed the Queen's street?我们已经过了皇后街了吗?
8How can I get to the nearest cinema, please?请问最近的电影院怎么走?
9Turn left at the crossroads.在十字路口左转。
10I'm going there myself. Let me lead the way.我也要去那儿,给你带路吧。
11Is this the right way to the British Museum?去大英博物馆是这么走吗?
12When you come to the roundabout, go straight on.到环岛之后直行。
13I'm a bit lost.我有点儿迷路了。
14I'm a stranger here.我对这附近不太熟悉。
15It's along that road on your left. You can't miss it.就在这条路的左手边。肯定能找着。
16How far is this address from here, please?请问这个地址离这儿还有多远?
17Carry straight on.一直往前走。
18It'll take you about 20 minutes to get there.大概要花20分钟。
19Ask someone else when you get there.到那儿之后再问问别人。
20Where does this road lead to?这条马路是通到哪儿的?
21Go straight along this street to the traffic lights.顺着这条街一直往前走走到红绿灯。
22Is it far to walk?走路过去远吗?
23Follow this path back for about a mile.沿着这条小路往回走一英里。
24It's just round the corner.就在拐角处。
25I'm not sure. I'm just passing through.我不清楚,我只是路过这儿。
26I'm sorry. I'm from out of town myself.对不起,我也是从别处来的。

1Most children start primary school at the age of five.小孩一般5岁上小学。
2Is your school a public school or private school?你们学校是公立的还是私立的?
3The pupils have five lessons every day.小学生一天上五节课。
4They study eleven subjects a week.一周有十一门课。
5There are three terms in a school year.一学年有三个学期。
6The timetable changes every year.课表每年都不一样。
7What time do classes start and finish?几点上课?几点下课?
8We all had to wear a school uniform.我们都要穿校服。
9Once a week we had a test.我们每周都有一次测验。
10Anybody who got a D had to do extra work during the lunch hour.成绩得D的同学在午饭的时候要做额外的功课。
11I miss the recess time that I had as a child.真怀念小时候无忧无虑的时光。
12Our chemistry class was cancelled for tomorrow.我们明天的化学课取消了。
13Could you play the tape again, please?您能再放一遍录音吗?
14Do you mind if I sit here?我坐这里你介意吗?
15No, of course not. Go ahead.当然不介意,坐吧。
16Feel free.自由了。
17Could you turn your mobile off, please?请关掉手机。
18I got a grant.我拿到助学金了。
19I've got my finals next term.下学期是我最后一个学期。
20I'm going to take a year off and go travelling.我要休学一年去旅行。
21She dropped out of the course.她不修那门课了。
22Are you going on the demonstration?你要做示范吗?
23I need to ask the bank for a loan.我要向银行贷款。
24It's got a very good reputation.它的口碑不错。

1 I got sacked.我被解雇了。
2 You have been demoted.你被降职了。
3 I am only a regular 9-to-5er.我只是一个平凡的朝九晚五上班族。
4 I had to wear a suit to work.我上班得穿西装。
5 I have to work very long hours.我不得不工作很长时间。
6 My working hours are not fixed.我的工作时间不固定。
7 We go off shift at six in the evening.我们每天下午六点下班。
8 I don't have to start work until ten.我十点钟才开始工作。
9 In the middle of something?在忙吗?
10 Let's start with you.就从你开始吧。
11 What are you up to?你正在做什么呢?
12 Can you just give me a ballpark figure?能不能给我一个大概的数字?
13 I don't have to take work home with me.我不用把工作带回家做。
14 He never arrives late and he always finishes his work on time.他从不迟到,而且总是按时完成工作。
15 You should give him a piece of your mind.你应该向他表达你的不满。
16 I heard that five people are going be laid off next month.我听说公司下个月要裁掉五个员工。
17 I refuse to work overtime during the weekend.我拒绝在周末时加班。
18 Today is terrible. It's been one thing after another.今天真是太可怕了,事情一件接着一件。
19 Could you fax this through to the head office?你能把这个传真发到总部吗?
20 Really busy! I had to work right through my lunch break.太忙了!我午休的时候都在干活。
21 I need to know who's available for the project team.我需要知道谁能参与这个项目。
22 I find it challenging. It requires a lot of concentration and determination.我觉得这份工作很有挑战性,需要充分的专注和很强的决断力。
23 Working for yourself isn't all that it's cracked up to be!给自己打工并不像大家说得那么好!

text_en: How was your day?

speaker: J

speaker: J

text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en Only two week's paternity leave? zh 只有两周的父亲假？（注：父亲假指新生儿诞生后的男性员工假期）

text_en: I'm taking a few days off next week. The kids are off school.

text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en I'm taking a few days off next week. The kids are off school. zh 下周我要请几天假。孩子们放假了。

text_zh: 你为什么不请一天病假呢？
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en Why don't you take a day of sick leave? zh 你为什么不请一天病假呢？

text_en: I'm asking for a three-day personal leave because my wife is giving birth.
text_zh: 因为我太太要生了，我想要请三天假。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en I'm asking for a three-day personal leave because my wife is giving birth. zh 因为我太太要生了，我想要请三天假。

text_en: Could we possibly discuss my salary sometime?
text_zh: 有空咱们谈谈我的工资吧？
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en Could we possibly discuss my salary sometime? zh 有空咱们谈谈我的工资吧？

text_en: It's enough to live on.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en It's enough to live on. zh 养家糊口是足够了。

text_en: You can have Saturdays and Sundays off.
text_zh: 周六周日你都可以休息。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en You can have Saturdays and Sundays off. zh 周六周日你都可以休息。

text_en: You may have one-month of paid holiday every year.
text_zh: 你每年有一个月的带薪假期。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en You may have one-month of paid holiday every year. zh 你每年有一个月的带薪假期。

text_en: We would like to start you off at 1500 Yuan a month, not including bonus and overtime pay.
text_zh: 开始的时候 1500 元一个月，不包括奖金和加班费。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en We would like to start you off at 1500 Yuan a month, not including bonus and overtime pay. zh 开始的时候 1500 元一个月，不包括奖金和加班费。

text_en: We'll supply you with an apartment with two bedrooms and a living room.
text_zh: 我们提供给你一套住房，包括两间卧室和一间客厅。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en We'll supply you with an apartment with two bedrooms and a living room. zh 我们提供给你一套住房，包括两间卧室和一间客厅。

text_en: We offer 1% commission on all your sales.
text_zh: 我们给你按照你的销售量的1%提成。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en We offer 1% commission on all your sales. zh 我们给你按照你的销售量的1%提成。

text_en: If you are satisfied with the conditions here, please sign this contract.
text_zh: 如果你对条款都满意的话请在合同上签字。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en If you are satisfied with the conditions here, please sign this contract. zh 如果你对条款都满意的话请在合同上签字。

text_en: The best thing about my job is that I get lots of benefits—a company pension, private health insurance and things like that.
text_zh: 这份工作最棒的地方是福利好，有公司养老金、个人健康保险和类似这样的其他福利。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type useful_expression tags en The best thing about my job is that I get lots of benefits—a company pension, private health insurance and things like that. zh 这份工作最棒的地方是福利好，有公司养老金、个人健康保险和类似这样的其他福利。

text_en: Have you finished going through the contract?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Have you finished going through the contract? zh
speaker: Paige

text_en: Yes, but I have a few questions for you.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes, but I have a few questions for you. zh
speaker: Kyle

text_en: Ok. Ask away.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Ok. Ask away. zh
speaker: P

text_en: First, I'd like to know if you offer employees sick leave.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en First, I'd like to know if you offer employees sick leave. zh
speaker: K

text_en: Yes, employees can take up to 10 days of sick leave per year. However, in order to get paid, you'll have to bring in a note from the doctor's.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes, employees can take up to 10 days of sick leave per year. However, in order to get paid, you'll have to bring in a note from the doctor's. zh
speaker: P

text_en: Even if I'm only sick for one day?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Even if I'm only sick for one day? zh
speaker: K

text_en: That's correct.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en That's correct. zh
speaker: P

text_en: That's pretty strict, if you ask me.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en That's pretty strict, if you ask me. zh
speaker: K

text_en: Well, we've had to add that to the contract because we found that many of our employees were taking almost one sick day a month, even though they weren't sick.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Well, we've had to add that to the contract because we found that many of our employees were taking almost one sick day a month, even though they weren't sick. zh
speaker: P

text_en: I see. I guess that makes sense.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en I see. I guess that makes sense. zh
speaker: K

text_en: Do you have any other questions?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Do you have any other questions? zh
speaker: P

text_en: Yes. Maternity leave is mentioned in the contract, but there's nothing in the contract about paternity leave. Do you offer anything to fathers?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes. Maternity leave is mentioned in the contract, but there's nothing in the contract about paternity leave. Do you offer anything to fathers? zh
speaker: K

text_en: We do actually. We can add that as an amendment to your contract.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en We do actually. We can add that as an amendment to your contract. zh
speaker: P

text_en: How many days of paternity leave do you offer?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en How many days of paternity leave do you offer? zh
speaker: K

text_en: Men are allowed to take 10 days of paternity leave for their first child.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Men are allowed to take 10 days of paternity leave for their first child. zh
speaker: P

text_en: Why are women allowed so much more time for maternity leave?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Why are women allowed so much more time for maternity leave? zh 是的，请签吧。
speaker: K

text_en: Well, women are the ones giving birth. I think it's fair to give them more time, don't you?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Well, women are the ones giving birth. I think it's fair to give them more time, don't you? zh 你还有其他问题吗?
speaker: P

text_en: I guess so. I don't have any other questions. Should I sign here then?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en I guess so. I don't have any other questions. Should I sign here then? zh 没错。
speaker: K

text_en: Yes, please.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes, please. zh 好，问吧。
speaker: P

text_en: Could we possibly discuss my salary some time?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Could we possibly discuss my salary some time? zh
speaker: K

text_en: Sure.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Sure. zh
speaker: P

text_en: First of all, I want you to know that I really like working for this company. Do you think I'm doing a good job here?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en First of all, I want you to know that I really like working for this company. Do you think I'm doing a good job here? zh
speaker: K

text_en: Well, you are a very hard-worker.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Well, you are a very hard-worker. zh
speaker: P

text_en: I try very hard. The problem is, my salary just isn't enough to live on. Now that I have a wife and a child to support, we hardly have enough money for food and rent.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en I try very hard. The problem is, my salary just isn't enough to live on. Now that I have a wife and a child to support, we hardly have enough money for food and rent. zh
speaker: K

text_en: There are trying times for everyone. What do you propose?
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en There are trying times for everyone. What do you propose? zh
speaker: P

text_en: I could really use a 5% raise.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en I could really use a 5% raise. zh
speaker: K

text_en: That's quite a bit. If I give you a raise, I'm going to have to give everyone a raise.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en That's quite a bit. If I give you a raise, I'm going to have to give everyone a raise. zh
speaker: P

text_en: Listen, if you give me a raise, I'll take on extra responsibilities.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Listen, if you give me a raise, I'll take on extra responsibilities. zh
speaker: K

text_en: That sounds reasonable. How about this? From now on, you can be responsible for scheduling. That means that if you can't find someone to cover a shift, then you'll have to do it.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en That sounds reasonable. How about this? From now on, you can be responsible for scheduling. That means that if you can't find someone to cover a shift, then you'll have to do it. zh
speaker: P

text_en: That's fine. Do I get over-time for any extra hours that I work?
text_zh: 当然算。不然我们就违法了。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en That's fine. Do I get over-time for any extra hours that I work? zh 当然算。不然我们就违法了。
speaker: K

text_en: Of course. It'd be against the law if we didn't.
text_zh: 我尽量卖力了。问题是，我的工资不够养家糊口。因为我家里还有老婆和孩子要养，我们的钱都不足以支付房租和饮食的开销。
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en Of course. It'd be against the law if we didn't. zh 我尽量卖力了。问题是，我的工资不够养家糊口。因为我家里还有老婆和孩子要养，我们的钱都不足以支付房租和饮食的开销。
speaker: P

text_en: That sounds good to me. I really appreciate it.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en That sounds good to me. I really appreciate it. zh 嗯，你工作非常勤恳。
speaker: K

text_en: You're welcome. Come in early tomorrow and I'll show you how to do the scheduling.
text_for_embedding: topic Pay and Welfare 薪资与福利 type dialogue_turn tags en You're welcome. Come in early tomorrow and I'll show you how to do the scheduling. zh 当然可以。
speaker: P

Dear Sir/ Madam,...亲爱的先生/女士,......
Thank you indeed / from the bottom of my heart.衷心感谢您。
Many thanks for your kind and warm letter.感谢您友好而热情的来信。
Thanks a million.万分感谢。
Please accept my sincere appreciation for...请接受我诚挚的感谢......

I really regret that I did not have an opportunity to personally thank you for...未能就......面谢,深表遗憾。

May an old friend congratulate you...请允许一位老朋友向您祝贺......
Mother just told us the cheerful news.母亲刚才告诉我们这令人高兴的消息。
So you've been promoted!好了,您终于晋升了!
Susie and I join in sending our love.苏茜和我都向您问好。
The best of everything to both of you.祝你们俩一切顺利。
You were made for each other.你们是天生的一对。
I knew it as soon as I met her.我初次见到她时就看出这一点。

text_en: Can I have your autograph please?
text_zh:
1The stars in show biz have a really easy life.演艺圈的明星们生活过得太舒适了。
2They live in luxury.他们过着奢华的生活。
3Talented stars are always cool.有才华的明星往往很酷。
4It's a very unpredictable field.这个圈子的事情很难预测。
5He won an Emmy for outstanding supporting actor.他荣获艾美奖最佳男配角。
6Producers are also the most powerful group in Hollywood.制片人也是好莱坞最具权力的一类人。
7The girl dreamed of entering show biz through advertisement.那个女孩梦想通过拍广告进入娱乐圈。
8They have lots of money, so they can buy almost anything they want.他们有大把的钱几乎想买什么就能买什么。
9Tom Cruise tops Forbes' annual celebrity list.汤姆·克鲁斯名列《福布斯》年度名人榜榜首。
10He's one of the few guaranteed bankable stars.他是为数不多的、最有票房保证的影星之一。
11They only do that to get even more publicity for their films and themselves.他们那么做只是为了给他们的电影和自己做宣传而已。
12One of Jackie Chang's films was a milestone in martial arts films.成龙有一部电影算得上是武打片的里程碑。
13It's interesting to see who is considered the best in their field.看看谁被认为是这行里最优秀的人,是件挺有意思的事。

text_en: Despite all the hype, I thought the film was pretty boring.

text_zh: 广告之后我们马上就回来。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en We'll be right back with you after a short commercial break. zh 广告之后我们马上就回来。

text_en: “Impossible is nothing” is the slogan of a famous company.
text_zh: “一切皆有可能”是某著名公司的广告语。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en “Impossible is nothing” is the slogan of a famous company. zh “一切皆有可能”是某著名公司的广告语。

text_en: It's a brilliant advert.
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en It's a brilliant advert. zh 这广告不错。

text_en: It really grabs my attention.
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en It really grabs my attention. zh 确实引起了我的注意。

text_en: She is doing a tour to promote her new album.
text_zh: 她正在进行巡演，宣传新专辑。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en She is doing a tour to promote her new album. zh 她正在进行巡演，宣传新专辑。

text_en: Advertisers know that shoppers will always compare one product with another.
text_zh: 广告商们深知消费者总要货比三家。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en Advertisers know that shoppers will always compare one product with another. zh 广告商们深知消费者总要货比三家。

text_en: Advertisers are experts at persuading people to spend their money.
text_zh: 广告商是劝人花钱的专家。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en Advertisers are experts at persuading people to spend their money. zh 广告商是劝人花钱的专家。

text_en: The tobacco industry has been trying very hard to improve its image.
text_zh: 烟草业一直以来都非常努力地改善自己的形象。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en The tobacco industry has been trying very hard to improve its image. zh 烟草业一直以来都非常努力地改善自己的形象。

text_en: We are trying to reach the under-18 market.
text_zh: 我们正在进军18岁以下的少儿市场。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en We are trying to reach the under-18 market. zh 我们正在进军18岁以下的少儿市场。

text_en: They are going to sponsor the next world cup.
text_zh: 他们打算赞助下届世界杯。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en They are going to sponsor the next world cup. zh 他们打算赞助下届世界杯。

text_zh: 所有选手都将穿上印有那个标志的上衣。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en All the players will wear that logo on their shirts. zh 所有选手都将穿上印有那个标志的上衣。

text_en: Advertising has a huge influence on all the choices we make.
text_zh: 广告对我们选择商品有着巨大的影响。
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en Advertising has a huge influence on all the choices we make. zh 广告对我们选择商品有着巨大的影响。

text_en: They like to catch young people because they know the meaning of loyalty.

text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type useful_expression tags en They like to catch young people because they know the meaning of loyalty. zh 他们想抓住年轻的消费人群，因为他们深知品牌忠实度的含义。

speaker: Neveah

text_en: I've never really thought about it before. I guess it doesn't bother me.
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type dialogue_turn tags en I've never really thought about it before. I guess it doesn't bother me. zh
speaker: Brody

speaker: N

text_en: I guess so. I usually buy name-brand clothing, shoes, and electronic goods. How about you?

speaker: B

text_en: I actually try to avoid name-brand items. I can't stand it when big companies advertise their products all over the place!
text_zh: 我觉得那广告相当不错！它确实吸引了我的注意力！
text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type dialogue_turn tags en I actually try to avoid name-brand items. I can't stand it when big companies advertise their products all over the place! zh 我觉得那广告相当不错！它确实吸引了我的注意力！
speaker: N

text_en: I know that advertisers are experts at persuading people to spend their money, but I think brand-name items are usually higher quality than generic brands.
text_zh: 那只是一家著名公司的广告语，没什么特别的。

speaker: B

text_en: I think that it's sensible to buy products that are higher quality than others when you want to buy something that's going to last a long time, but I don't think it always makes sense.

text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type dialogue_turn tags en I think that it's sensible to buy products that are higher quality than others when you want to buy something that's going to last a long time, but I don't think it always makes sense. zh 你觉得大街上“一切皆有可能”的广告牌做得怎么样？
speaker: N

text_en: Do you have a brand preference for anything?

speaker: B

text_en: I do for shower items like shower gel and shampoo, but I don't for higher-end items.

speaker: N

text_en: What do you think about the “Impossible is Nothing” billboard on the high street?
text_zh: 我相信在挑选耐用消费品的时候，名牌的质量都会高于其他品牌，不过这种选择方式并不是永远奏效。

speaker: N

text_en: I think it's a brilliant advert! It really grabs my attention!

text_for_embedding: topic Advertising 广告 type dialogue_turn tags en I think it's a brilliant advert! It really grabs my attention! zh 我一般尽量避免买名牌。大公司到处给他们的商品做广告，这让我难以忍受！
speaker: B

speaker: N

speaker: B

text_en: While I think it's great that they're trying to get people to quit smoking, but I don't really care for the advertisement.
text_zh: 不过你还是应该对它们给予充分的承认。人们是时候该开始关注吸烟的危害了。

speaker: N

text_en: Why not?
text_zh: 你说得对。我很高兴有一个户外广告牌上做的是促进身体健康的广告，但真不知道青少年对上面的话能理解多少？

text_for_embedding: topic Other Issues 其他社会问题 type dialogue_turn tags en I never really give them money because I don't want to contribute to their addictions. zh
speaker: E

text_en: Homeless youth can easily become involved with drugs and prostitution. Do you do anything to help them?
text_for_embedding: topic Other Issues 其他社会问题 type dialogue_turn tags en Homeless youth can easily become involved with drugs and prostitution. Do you do anything to help them? zh
speaker: D

text_en: I usually ask them if they want some food and then give them something to eat. I figure that if they're homeless, they're probably hungry.
text_for_embedding: topic Other Issues 其他社会问题 type dialogue_turn tags en I usually ask them if they want some food and then give them something to eat. I figure that if they're homeless, they're probably hungry. zh
speaker: E

text_en: That's a good idea. Do they usually accept the food?
text_zh: 我只能寄希望于未来这种情况会有所改善。
text_for_embedding: topic Other Issues 其他社会问题 type dialogue_turn tags en That's a good idea. Do they usually accept the food? zh 我只能寄希望于未来这种情况会有所改善。
speaker: D

text_en: Almost always. However, sometimes they get mad at me for not giving them any cash.
text_zh: 政客们总是忽略工人阶级的问题，他们更倾向于关注如何能令富人和名流生活得更好。
text_for_embedding: topic Other Issues 其他社会问题 type dialogue_turn tags en Almost always. However, sometimes they get mad at me for not giving them any cash. zh 政客们总是忽略工人阶级的问题，他们更倾向于关注如何能令富人和名流生活得更好。
speaker: E

text_en: It's sad how more and more young people are sleeping on the streets in London now.
text_zh: 另外，现在的失业率也居高不下。
text_for_embedding: topic Other Issues 其他社会问题 type dialogue_turn tags en It's sad how more and more young people are sleeping on the streets in London now. zh 另外，现在的失业率也居高不下。
speaker: D

text_en: The cost of living in London is just too high for most people.
text_zh: 附近已经没有什么能买得起的房子了。如果房价能降降，生活拮据的人就能少一些。
text_for_embedding: topic Other Issues 其他社会问题 type dialogue_turn tags en The cost of living in London is just too high for most people. zh 附近已经没有什么能买得起的房子了。如果房价能降降，生活拮据的人就能少一些。
speaker: E

text_en: It's true. The economy is in a bit of mess at the moment.
text_zh: 你知道吗，现在仅仅靠最低工资已经很难支付房租，就更别提饮食和其他花销了。
text_for_embedding: topic Other Issues 其他社会问题 type dialogue_turn tags en It's true. The economy is in a bit of mess at the moment. zh 你知道吗，现在仅仅靠最低工资已经很难支付房租，就更别提饮食和其他花销了。
speaker: D

text_en: Did you know that few people can pay the rent on minimum wage, let alone pay for food and other living costs?
text_zh: 没错。现在的经济有点儿不景气。
text_for_embedding: topic Other Issues 其他社会问题 type dialogue_turn tags en Did you know that few people can pay the rent on minimum wage, let alone pay for food and other living costs? zh 没错。现在的经济有点儿不景气。
speaker: E

text_en: There just isn't enough affordable housing to go around. If only the housing cost would drop, fewer people would be in financial trouble.
text_zh: 伦敦的生活费用对很多人来说实在是太昂贵了。

speaker: D

text_en: Added to that is the high unemployment rate right now.
text_zh: 通常都会接受。不过，有的时候他们会因为我一分钱都没给而气得要死。

speaker: E

text_en: Something's got to change—and it's got to happen soon.
text_zh: 好主意。他们会接受吃的吗？

text_en: The destruction of the rainforest is very worrying.
text_zh: 雨林的破坏程度令人担忧。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en The destruction of the rainforest is very worrying. zh 雨林的破坏程度令人担忧。

text_en: The biggest issue is water.
text_zh: 最大的问题在于水资源。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en The biggest issue is water. zh 最大的问题在于水资源。

text_en: Buy environmentally friendly products whenever possible.
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en Buy environmentally friendly products whenever possible. zh 尽量购买环保制品。

text_en: Use public transport instead of taking your car.
text_zh: 乘坐公共交通设施代替自驾车。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en Use public transport instead of taking your car. zh 乘坐公共交通设施代替自驾车。

text_en: Global warming is the rise in temperature of the earth's atmosphere.
text_zh: 全球变暖是指地球上的大气普遍升温。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en Global warming is the rise in temperature of the earth's atmosphere. zh 全球变暖是指地球上的大气普遍升温。

text_en: That island is uninhabitable because of radioactive mine.
text_zh: 这个岛是不适宜居住的，因为有放射性矿物质。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en That island is uninhabitable because of radioactive mine. zh 这个岛是不适宜居住的，因为有放射性矿物质。

text_en: Rain mixed with toxic chemicals from factories is known as acid rain.
text_zh: 雨水与工厂排放的有毒化学物质混合在一起产生了我们熟知的酸雨。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en Rain mixed with toxic chemicals from factories is known as acid rain. zh 雨水与工厂排放的有毒化学物质混合在一起产生了我们熟知的酸雨。

text_en: There are lots of things we can all do to protect the environment.
text_zh: 我们每个人都可以为保护环境做很多事情。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en There are lots of things we can all do to protect the environment. zh 我们每个人都可以为保护环境做很多事情。

text_en: There's a large chemical factory in our town, which has polluted the river in the last year.
text_zh: 我们镇上有家很大的化工厂，去年污染了这条河。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en There's a large chemical factory in our town, which has polluted the river in the last year. zh 我们镇上有家很大的化工厂，去年污染了这条河。

text_en: Make sure your car runs on unleaded petrol and your home uses renewable sources of energy.
text_zh: 确保开车用无铅汽油，在家使用可持续能源。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en Make sure your car runs on unleaded petrol and your home uses renewable sources of energy. zh 确保开车用无铅汽油，在家使用可持续能源。

text_en: Take glass, paper and plastic to a recycling centre and your empty bottles to a bottle bank.
text_zh: 玻璃废纸和塑料制品要回收，空瓶子也要集中收集。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en Take glass, paper and plastic to a recycling centre and your empty bottles to a bottle bank. zh 玻璃废纸和塑料制品要回收，空瓶子也要集中收集。

text_en: The gradual rise in the earth's temperature is known as the greenhouse effect.
text_zh: 普遍认为是温室效应造成全球变暖。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en The gradual rise in the earth's temperature is known as the greenhouse effect. zh 普遍认为是温室效应造成全球变暖。

text_en: Exhaust fumes from cars and other vehicles cause a great deal of damage to the environment.
text_zh: 汽车和其他交通工具产生的尾气造成了严重的环境污染。
text_for_embedding: topic Threats to Our Environment 环境面临的威胁 type useful_expression tags en Exhaust fumes from cars and other vehicles cause a great deal of damage to the environment. zh 汽车和其他交通工具产生的尾气造成了严重的环境污染。

text_en: Farmers contribute to environmental damage by spraying crops with pesticides which stay in the soil for years.
text_zh: 农民向庄稼喷洒的农药会长年残留在土壤里，造成环境污染。

text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type useful_expression tags en The lava destroyed everything in its path. zh 岩浆毁灭了所到之处的所有东西。

text_en: The water level has been rising steadily.
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type useful_expression tags en The water level has been rising steadily. zh 河水在持续上涨。

text_en: The earthquake, measuring 7 on the Richter scale, was enough to cause large cracks in several roads.
text_zh: 这次地震大约里氏7级，已经有足够的威力使许多道路断裂。
