text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type useful_expression tags en A twenty-metre wall of water swept up the beach. zh 米高的巨浪横扫海滩。

text_en: Along the path of the twister cars were lifted hundreds of metres into the air.
text_zh: 龙卷风所到之处，汽车旋转着被卷上几百米的高空中。
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type useful_expression tags en Along the path of the twister cars were lifted hundreds of metres into the air. zh 龙卷风所到之处，汽车旋转着被卷上几百米的高空中。

text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type useful_expression tags en This year's crop has been lost. zh 今年的庄稼颗粒无收。

text_en: The land here is so dry now that farmers are unable to grow anything.
text_zh: 土地干旱太严重了，农民们种不了任何作物。

speaker: M

text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en No, but my father's car was destroyed in a flood once. It actually happened the day after he bought the car! zh 你是哪里人?

text_en: That sure didn't last long!

speaker: M

text_en: Do you remember when Hurricane Katrina passed through the New Orleans?
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en Do you remember when Hurricane Katrina passed through the New Orleans? zh
speaker: M

text_en: Yes, that was just a few years ago.
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en Yes, that was just a few years ago. zh
speaker: J

text_en: What was your first impression of it when you saw all the survivors wading through the waters trying to get to the stadium?
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en What was your first impression of it when you saw all the survivors wading through the waters trying to get to the stadium? zh
speaker: M

text_en: In all honesty, I thought that I was watching a news story about people from a third world country.
text_zh: 没错，不过捐款可以帮助人们重建生活。
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en In all honesty, I thought that I was watching a news story about people from a third world country. zh 没错，不过捐款可以帮助人们重建生活。
speaker: J

text_en: I know. It was absolutely shocking that the people were taken care of so poorly in America.
text_zh: 在自然灾害来临的时候，再多的钱也救不了你的命。
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en I know. It was absolutely shocking that the people were taken care of so poorly in America. zh 在自然灾害来临的时候，再多的钱也救不了你的命。
speaker: M

text_en: In fact, I thought there was less chaos in Asia when the Tsunami hit.
text_zh: 在“卡特里娜”飓风事件之前，我从来没有见过那么多美国人从齐腰的水里挣扎着爬上岸，然后接连好多天坐在房顶上，等待救援。
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en In fact, I thought there was less chaos in Asia when the Tsunami hit. zh 在“卡特里娜”飓风事件之前，我从来没有见过那么多美国人从齐腰的水里挣扎着爬上岸，然后接连好多天坐在房顶上，等待救援。
speaker: J

text_en: You might be right. The evacuation and medical teams were able to assist the survivors almost immediately in Asia, whereas in New Orleans, some people went without food or water for days.

text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en You might be right. The evacuation and medical teams were able to assist the survivors almost immediately in Asia, whereas in New Orleans, some people went without food or water for days. zh 在亚洲海啸爆发前，我从来没看见过20米高的水墙横扫海滩的情景。
speaker: M

text_en: It was such a disgrace.

speaker: J

text_en: Unfortunately, there were quite a few victims in both situations.
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en Unfortunately, there were quite a few victims in both situations. zh 这实在是太丢脸了。
speaker: M

text_en: Mother nature has amazing strength to destroy whatever is in her path.
text_zh: 其实，我觉得在亚洲海啸爆发的时候情况也没有那么混乱。
text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en Mother nature has amazing strength to destroy whatever is in her path. zh 其实，我觉得在亚洲海啸爆发的时候情况也没有那么混乱。
speaker: J

speaker: M

text_en: Before Hurricane Katrina, I'd never seen so many Americans wading in water up to their waists and sitting on rooftops for days while they waited for help.
text_zh: 实话实说，我当时就好像在看一个有关第三世界国家的新闻报道。

text_en: When it comes to natural disasters, no amount of money can save your life.

text_en: That may be true, but contributions can help people start to re-build their lives.

text_for_embedding: topic Disasters 自然灾害 type dialogue_turn tags en That may be true, but contributions can help people start to re-build their lives. zh 记得，不过就是几年前的事。

text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type useful_expression tags en What's it like outside today? zh 今天外面的天气如何？

text_en: It's a lovely day, isn't it?
text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type useful_expression tags en It's a lovely day, isn't it? zh 多好的天气呀，对吧？

text_en: We have lovely sunshine.
text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type useful_expression tags en We have lovely sunshine. zh 阳光特别好。

text_en: It's fairly mild for this time of year.
text_zh: 就现在这个时节来说天气是相当暖和了。
text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type useful_expression tags en It's fairly mild for this time of year. zh 就现在这个时节来说天气是相当暖和了。

text_en: It's only a shower.
text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type useful_expression tags en It's only a shower. zh 不过是场小阵雨。

text_en: I think there'll be a thunderstorm.
text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type useful_expression tags en I think there'll be a thunderstorm. zh 我看要下雷阵雨了。

text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type useful_expression tags en It seems to be clearing up. zh 天似乎要转晴。

text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type useful_expression tags en It'll soon pass over. zh 马上就会过去的。

text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type useful_expression tags en The fog is starting to lift. zh 雾开始散了。

text_for_embedding: topic Weather 天气 type dialogue_turn tags en It's supposed to snow early tomorrow morning and then tomorrow afternoon there's a chance of freezing rain. zh

topic_title_zh: 主厨亲自出马处理投诉
text_en: Sir, I couldn't help but notice you've barely touched your halibut. Is there something amiss?

topic_title_zh: 主厨亲自出马处理投诉
text_en: To be brutally honest, it's inedible. The fish is overcooked to the point of being rubbery, and the sauce has split — it's a pool of grease with a few sad capers floating in it. For a restaurant of this caliber, this is frankly inexcusable.
text_zh: 实话实说，这简直无法入口。鱼肉老得像橡胶，酱汁还分层了——就是一滩油里漂着几颗可怜的酸豆。对于这个级别的餐厅来说，这简直不可原谅。

topic_title_zh: 主厨亲自出马处理投诉
text_en: I'm genuinely mortified. There's no excusing this. The chef has been informed, and he's appalled at the lapse in quality control. He's requested to prepare a fresh dish personally — not merely a replacement, but an entirely different creation as a gesture of atonement.
text_zh: 我真的很惭愧。这无可辩解。我已经告知主厨，他对这次品控失职感到震惊。他请求亲自为您重新制作一份——不只是一份替代品，而是一道完全不同的创作，以示弥补。

topic_title_zh: 主厨亲自出马处理投诉
text_en: I'm not in the habit of giving second chances. But I'll hear what the chef has in mind.
text_zh: 我向来不太给人第二次机会。不过我倒想听听主厨的想法。

topic_title_zh: 主厨亲自出马处理投诉
text_en: He's proposing a pan-roasted John Dory with a saffron-basil emulsion, caramelized fennel, and a citrus beurre noisette. It's an off-menu dish he's been developing for the spring tasting menu. He assures me it's a far more inspired composition.
text_zh: 他建议做一道香煎约翰多利鱼，配藏红花罗勒乳液、焦糖茴香和柑橘焦化黄油酱。这是他一直在为春季品鉴菜单打磨的一道隐藏菜品。他向我保证，这道菜在创作上要用心得多。

topic_title_zh: 主厨亲自出马处理投诉
text_en: John Dory is notoriously difficult to cook properly. The window between underdone and overdone is razor-thin.
text_zh: 约翰多利鱼出了名的难料理。生熟之间的窗口极窄，稍纵即逝。

text_en: Precisely why he chose it. He wants to demonstrate that what you experienced earlier was an anomaly — not our standard. He's personally overseeing every step from filleting to plating.
